faq_heading: Surrey houses under $1 million: your questions answered

faq.q: How many Surrey houses sell for under $1,000,000?
faq.a: 116 of 946, or 12%. A further 245 sold in the next range up, $1,000,000 to $1,199,999.

faq.q: What is the median price of a house in Surrey?
faq.a: $1,300,000 from November 1, 2025 to October 31, 2026, so $1,000,000 is below the middle of the market. The middle half sold between $1,100,000 and $1,534,250.

faq.q: Which Surrey area has the lowest house prices?
faq.a: Bridgeview, at $1,040,000 across 11 sales at $546 a square foot, median year built 1956. The tenth lowest was West Newton at $1,271,500.

faq.q: How fast do Surrey houses sell?
faq.a: 33 days at the median, closing at 95.6% of the last list price, with 9% above list.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Figures are Paragon closed and pending sales to October 31, 2026. A pending sale is firm but has not completed, so its price can still change. A median is shown only where at least 5 homes sold. The live search is not connected yet (Jerry’s saved search, price filter $1,000,000).

In Surrey, 116 of the 946 houses (12%) sold under $1,000,000. The median was $1,300,000, with the middle half between $1,100,000 and $1,534,250. The busiest price range, $1,200,000 to $1,499,999, had 328 sales.

blocks.text: Buying a house under $1,000,000 in Surrey

In Bridgeview the median house sold for $1,040,000 across 11 sales, $40,000 over $1,000,000. Across Surrey the median house took 33 days to sell and closed at 95.6% of the last list price, with 9% of the 946 sales above list. Check the roof age and foundation.
